description.text:
The Dynamax Clash V Starter Deck (极巨争锋 V起始卡组) came out on 19 May 2023 with the Dynamax Clash boosters, the Sword & Shield series' first starter deck in Simplified Chinese. Each box held a ready-to-play 60-card deck made up at random from 230 different non-holo cards, so the decks varied from box to box, and a one-card bonus pack: one of 40 cards, 25 non-holo and 15 holo, the holos being rarer.

Its cards are numbered out of 207. Fifteen holo cards are numbered past that, 208 to 222: Gossifleur, Eldegoss, Yamper, Boltund, Milcery, Alcremie, Silicobra, Sandaconda, Nickit and Thievul, Butterfree V, Butterfree VMAX, Pokémon Center Lady and two Sonia cards. For the launch, gyms and shops ran open-and-play events from 19 to 21 May 2023, where buying a deck at the event was the way in.
